harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: the hold of EVERY register of the A quad behind a tensor word (kind mma, hold_a_mov with reg): one QMMA.SF.16832.F32.E4M3.E2M1.E8 or HMMA.16816.F32.BF16 and, d issue cycles behind it, a MOV that rewrites R16, R17, R18 or R19 of its A quad - the result may not change; with and without one tensor word 7 cycles in front; every class with its positive control (the same MOV in front of the tensor word: it must be wrong) - on a Workstation Edition card, the probe alone

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

provenance.dep_table_commit: c8d79a6 The sm_120 dependency table prices the upper register of an IMAD.WIDE result apart, and CS2R -> IMAD is 6: two p

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256

QMMA.SF.16832.F32.E4M3.E2M1.E8: CONTROL: MOV rewrites the A-fragment register IN FRONT of the MMA (the result must change: expect 0 % good) [the rewritten register is R16 of the A quad R16..R19]
